an online decision aid for persons having a genetic disposition to cancer and their partner during reproductive decision-making is feasible and effective.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and evaluation of a web-based decision aid for persons at risk of hereditary cancer and their partners, to facilitate their reproductive decision-making.
the development of a decision aid for couples who are at risk for heredity cancer, and who are faced with the dilemma of whether or not to start a family.
the development of an online tool to support reproductive decision-making in couples at risk for heredity cancer.

the development of the decision aid was a success, as the results from the two-phase usability test and the pilot testing were positive and the final product will be tested in a large pretest–postest study.
the development of an online tool for decision support in the reproductive decision-making process for persons having a genetic disposition for hereditary breast and/or ovarian cancer is feasible.

a user-centered development of a decision aid can result in a tool that is perceived as useful and acceptable by the target group.
